Usage: rhythm-sightread report <report.json>... [-o <file>]... [--md | --html | --sarif | --json]

Renders one or more JSON reports a review saved into another format, by the
extension of each -o file: .md, .html, .sarif or .json. --md, --html, --sarif or
--json prints that format to stdout instead, for example to append to
$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Several reports merge into one, for example the reports of
several CI jobs. The JSONL stream comes only from a review (--jsonl). It needs
no network.

Flags:
  --diff                keep every changed hunk the reports hold
  --html                print the HTML report to stdout
  --json                print the merged rhythm-sightread/v1 JSON report to
                        stdout
  --md                  print Markdown to stdout
  -o, --output <file>   write the merged report to this file (repeatable; .md,
                        .html, .sarif or .json)
  --redact-paths        show paths relative to the project only (default on when
                        CI is set)
  --sarif               print SARIF 2.1.0 to stdout

Examples:
  rhythm-sightread report review.json -o review.html
  rhythm-sightread report web.json api.json -o all.md -o all.sarif
  rhythm-sightread report review.json --md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
